workflows.title: Create the patient chart from a new referral in OpenEMR
workflows.app: OpenEMR 8.0.0.3 (GPL-3.0), local test copy with made-up patients
workflows.evidence: On 2026-10-11 this bundle ran over 8 made-up referrals on a local OpenEMR test copy. 7 saved and a separate REST and SQL read matched 12 of 12 fields; the duplicate-name case stopped at OpenEMR's duplicate check. Engine certification was off for those runs.
workflows.usage: Start signed in to OpenEMR on Patient > New (/interface/new/new_comprehensive.php) at 1280x800. benchmark/openemr_local in this repository brings up a matching synthetic copy.

workflows.title: Enter a health-facility claim in openIMIS
workflows.evidence: benchmark/openimis_claims holds the pinned reference environment. A packaged bundle is not published yet.
